result_summary: For any physical cross block B of an arbitrary quadratic-affine residual with cap-one product inputs and arbitrary self blocks: if sr(B)>=5/2 then H_1/2<=13.135700 ||B||_F^-1/2 with no leverage gate; if sr(B)>=3/2 and one-side range leverage<=3/4 then H_1/2<=17.596217 ||B||_F^-1/2. The proof combines the reviewed regularized determinant Fourier envelope with E3>=||B||_F^6/32 or E2>=||B||_F^4/6.
candidate_refuted: A universal arbitrary-self bound H_1/2(R)<=C||B||_F^-1/2 for every nonzero cross block is false: R=(X+Y)^2 for iid Uniform[-1/2,1/2] has B=[1] but E R^-1/2=infinity.

partner_applied.applied_inequality: For exact rank-two B with sr(B)>=3/2 in the partner one-sided-isolation setting, ||p_Q||_infinity<9.822 |d|^-1/4 ||B||_F^-3/4; if ||B||_F>=768^-1/4 and |d|>=1/4 this is <48.273.

other_dependency_applied.scope: matching banks with ||B1||_F^2||B2||_F^2>=1/768 and scalar-square transducer
other_dependency_applied.new_application: arbitrary-self matching bank gives density <60.278 if sr>=5/2 and |a|>=1/4; <80.746 if sr>=3/2, leverage<=3/4 and |a|>=1/4
